integrity: Combinatorial cover and equivariant homology boundary proved directly; finite checker and its real output embedded; no independent scientific audit asserted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform theorem is restricted to two-subset Kneser graphs and cutoff two; equivariance is asserted for integral homology only, not for the wedge equivalence. Finite checker tests n=4 through 8; all-n theorem has a separate structural proof. Related unindexed formulations may exist.
title: Uniform three-sphere wedges and integral symmetry for two-independence Kneser complexes
